gold_note: Slanted sauropodomorph cladogram. Where lines converge, each was traced from its tip at 45° and measured row by row: the Marasuchus-Herrerasaurus pair, Eoraptor and the rest meet at the root (three-way); Plateosauravus, the Jingshanosaurus-Yunnanosaurus clade and the sauropod stem meet at node 12 (the two lines overlap only as they converge); six branches fan from node 17. Node 5 sits on ‘G.’ sinensis's line, which is read as Prosauropoda's stem below it. Sauropodomorpha (node 1), Prosauropoda (node 5) and Sauropoda (node 17) are kept as internal labels; the node numbers and the 'outgroup' bracket are not. 33 tips, 3 polytomies (3, 3, 6 children); 3 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
